**Chinese name:** 林德气体（中国）有限公司 (Líndé Qìtǐ (Zhōngguó) Yǒuxiàn Gōngsī)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
A foreign (German/UK-headquartered) industrial gas major with confirmed on-the-ground manufacturing in China specifically to supply chip fabs — not merely a sales office. Linde built and started up dedicated ultra-high-purity nitrogen generation and air-separation plants in Shanghai for named China fabs, including a 20-year supply contract with GTA Semiconductor in Lingang and an air-separation plant serving HLMC (Hua Hong).
:::

## What does this firm supply?

Ultra-high-purity industrial and electronic gases (nitrogen, oxygen, argon, and specialty electronic gases) piped or delivered directly to fab customers — confirmed named customers include GTA Semiconductor and Shanghai Huali Microelectronics (HLMC), with broader on-site gas production facilities across China's major fab clusters.

## Capability Trajectory

- **2009**: UHP nitrogen/oxygen plant + H2 generator for new 300mm fab in Dalian (ops early 2009)
- **2017**: Multiple on-site N2 plants for China electronics fabs, >110,000 Nm3/h combined, on stream end-2017
- **2020**: Air separation plant + on-site N2/CDA started up in Shanghai to supply HLMC (Hua Hong)
- **2020**: First of two UHP N2 generators started in Shanghai Lingang for GTA Semiconductor (20-yr deal)

## Manufacturing Sites in China

- **Linde LienHwa on-site N2 plant for GTA Semiconductor** (Shanghai (Lingang Industrial Zone)) — UHP nitrogen generators (2nd unit due 2022); supplies N2, O2, Ar, CO2, CDA to GTA's fab
- **Linde air separation plant for HLMC** (Shanghai) — ASU supplying N2, high-purity O2, Ar; on-site N2 generators and CDA
- **Linde UHP N2/O2 plant for Dalian 300mm fab** (Dalian) — Integrated UHP nitrogen and oxygen plant, hydrogen generator, Ar/He supply (customer unnamed)
